unresolved.why: NE's Hanoi is a hybrid matching no real layout: it already contains Hà Tây (merged 1 Aug 2008) but not Mê Linh (in Hanoi since 1 Aug 2008; NE leaves it in Vĩnh Phúc). Before 2008 it holds two provinces (Hanoi and Hà Tây).
checked: NE geometry: point grid over Mê Linh falls in VNM-464
unresolved.needs: district-level atoms (geoBoundaries VNM ADM2, CC BY; or GADM — not redistributable)

unresolved.why: Inside NE's Hanoi atom; no separate atom.
NE's Vĩnh Phúc still contains Mê Linh, which belongs to Hanoi since 1 Aug 2008.

Four communes of Lương Sơn moved to Hanoi on 1 Aug 2008; at NE's scale it cannot be established on which side of NE's Hòa Bình/Hanoi line they lie, so neither the pre- nor the post-2008 outline can be asserted.
unresolved.needs: commune-level atoms for Lương Sơn / Quốc Oai / Thạch Thất (geoBoundaries VNM ADM3)

unresolved.why: Tân Đức commune moved from Ba Vì (Hà Tây/Hanoi) to Việt Trì in 2008 (Resolution 14/2008/QH12); which side of NE's line it lies on is not established, and the exact effective day of 14/2008 was not found.
unresolved.needs: commune-level atoms (geoBoundaries VNM ADM3) and the text of Resolution 14/2008/QH12

unresolved.what: Lai Châu (new) and Điện Biên from 2004
unresolved.why: NE's Lai Châu/Điện Biên line does not follow the 2004 split (NE Điện Biên 11,797 km² vs 9,554 km² in Resolution 22/2003), and the new Lai Châu includes Than Uyên, which NE leaves in Lào Cai.
NE's Lào Cai still includes Than Uyên district (in Lai Châu since 1 Jan 2004).

Mergers of 1976, Hanoi's 1978 and 1991 boundary changes, the 1979 Vũng Tàu-Côn Đảo special zone, the 1989 and 1991-92 splits (with district transfers, e.g. Mê Linh to Vĩnh Phú, five Hanoi districts to Hà Tây), and the 1996 transfer of Ngân Sơn and Ba Bể from Cao Bằng to Bắc Kạn put lines inside NE atoms; per-province effective days of the 1991 resolution were not established.
unresolved.needs: district-level atoms (geoBoundaries VNM ADM2) and per-province decree dates
